__commentMySqlConnectionString: Provide the real MySQL connection string through the ConnectionStrings__MySql environment variable or your secret store. Do not commit database passwords into appsettings files.
__commentJwtSigningKey: Provide the real JWT signing key through the ASPNETCORE_JWT_SIGNINGKEY environment variable or your secret store. Do not commit signing keys into appsettings files.
__commentFrontendAllowedOrigins: Frontend:AllowedOrigins should list the exact React app origins allowed to call this API, for example http://localhost:5173 for a Vite dev server.
__commentConsumetBaseUrl: Point Scrapers:ConsumetBaseUrl at the SakugaVault scraper service or another Consumet-compatible API. For local development outside Docker, http://localhost:3100 is the default.
